tools.name: play_word_search
tools.description: Creates a ready-made word search puzzle for a theme and level, drawn from the 11 themed word pools (Christmas, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Fall, Winter, Bible, Animal, Math, Science, 4th of July and Kids), at an easy, medium or hard level. Gives the letter grid, the words to find with their positions,

tools.name: make_word_search
tools.description: Makes a word search from words the user supplies, 3 to 40 words of 3 to 15 letters. Gives the letter grid, where each word is placed, the words that did not fit with the reason, and a link that opens the WordsDesk maker with the same words to print, save a PDF or share. The widget is playable.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: Lists the 11 puzzle themes with the number of words in each pool, the grid size and word count of each level, sample words and the WordsDesk page of each theme.

tools.name: theme_words
tools.description: Gives the words in one theme's word pool, the same lists the website draws its puzzles from, optionally only the words up to a maximum length, so words can be picked for a custom puzzle.
